_readme: This file IS the curriculum. The app renders whatever is here — nothing is hardcoded.
Edit freely: rename, reorder (order fields), add/remove campuses, modules, lessons, schools.
Run `npm run seed` after any edit. Seeding is idempotent (upserts by slug): safe to re-run always.
Removing an item here does NOT delete it in the DB — archive it in the DB instead, so member progress survives.
lesson.body is markdown and is intentionally left as outline stubs — fill them in as you record/write.
lens: null = both schools; 'founder' or 'artist' = only shown to that school's members.
meta objects are free-form: add whatever properties you want, the schema accepts them.

campuses.name: Foundation (Founders)
campuses.promise: Total clarity on what you sell and who buys it — and your first outreach live.
campuses.fastWin: First real outreach messages sent to real prospects.

modules.title: The Offer
modules.summary: What you actually sell, in one sentence a stranger understands.
modules.assignment: Write your one-sentence offer and pin it.

questions.question: What makes an offer strong, per this module?
choices: It lists every feature you have
A stranger understands it in one sentence
It sounds impressive to other founders

questions.question: Who is the audience test for your one-sentence offer?
What should you do with the offer once it's written?
choices: Keep refining it forever before sharing
Pin it and use it as-is in real conversations
Wait until you have more proof

modules.title: The ICP
modules.summary: Role, vertical, region, budget signal. 'Everyone' means no one.
modules.assignment: Written ICP with all four dimensions.

questions.question: How many dimensions does a written ICP need, per this module?
What's wrong with targeting 'everyone'?
choices: It takes too long to write

questions.question: Which of these is one of the four ICP dimensions from this module?

modules.title: Proof & Positioning
modules.summary: What you can honestly claim today, and how to present it without a track record.
modules.assignment: One-page proof inventory.

modules.title: First Contact
modules.summary: Manual outreach before any tools. The skill before the scale.
modules.assignment: 10 messages sent to 10 real ICP prospects.

modules.title: Blocker: Fear of Pitching
modules.summary: You have to pitch more businesses than you think, on more channels than you think.

modules.title: The Operating Rhythm
modules.summary: The weekly cadence: outreach blocks, follow-up blocks, content block.
modules.assignment: Calendar built, first week executed.

campuses.name: Foundation (Artists)
campuses.promise: Clarity on what you're actually selling — attention → fandom → career — and your first intent-driven content live.
campuses.fastWin: First content live with a clear capture mechanism.

modules.title: What an Artist Actually Sells
modules.summary: Attention becomes fandom becomes career. Every marketing act serves one link.
modules.assignment: Map your chain, mark your current position.

questions.question: What is the chain described in this module?
What should every marketing act serve, per this module?
What does the assignment ask you to mark on your chain map?

modules.title: Positioning the Name
modules.summary: What makes you followable beyond the work: story, register, the thing people attach to.
modules.assignment: Positioning statement — who follows you and why.

modules.title: The Asset Inventory
modules.summary: Songs, performances, footage, story moments. Remix what exists before making anything new.
modules.assignment: Full inventory, tagged by what it could become.

modules.title: First Capture
modules.summary: Reach vs owned attention: follows, DMs, saves. First keyword-style CTA on your strongest asset.
modules.assignment: First capture-driven post live.

modules.title: Blocker: 'The Work Should Speak for Itself'
modules.summary: It doesn't. The best-marketed song beats the best song, every week, everywhere.

modules.title: The Operating Rhythm
modules.summary: Creation block, posting cadence, engagement block. Sustainable beats heroic.
modules.assignment: Calendar built, first week executed.

campuses.name: Outreach (Cold-to-Close)
campuses.promise: A complete outbound system — sequence, conversation, pipeline, call, proposal, close.
campuses.fastWin: Sequence live and generating replies, pipeline tracking every conversation.

modules.title: The Real Funnel
modules.summary: The honest math of outbound: every stage leaks; know your numbers so you fix the right leak.
modules.assignment: Build your funnel tracker with every stage defined.

modules.title: Sequence Design
modules.summary: Warm → connect → message ladder. The goal is a REPLY, not a booked call.
modules.assignment: Full sequence written, every message drafted.

modules.title: The Value Asset
modules.summary: The thing you give before you ask — and what makes it valuable vs a brochure.
modules.assignment: Your value asset built.

modules.title: The Bridge (the #1 leak)
modules.summary: Sending the asset is not booking the call. Every asset send gets a bridge follow-up, always.
modules.assignment: Bridge scripts written and wired into the sequence.

modules.title: The DM Setting Pipeline
modules.summary: Conversations as a pipeline, not an inbox. Every conversation gets a stage and a next action.
modules.assignment: Pipeline built, all live conversations staged.

modules.title: Blocker: Volume Avoidance
modules.summary: You're polishing message #3 instead of sending message #300.

modules.title: Reactivation
modules.summary: Cold leads are an asset. 14 days silent → reactivation → recontact → back to live.
modules.assignment: Reactivation rules and recontact messages built.

modules.title: Discovery Calls
modules.summary: Qualification, budget questions, listening ratios, concrete next steps.
modules.assignment: Call framework written; first discovery run.

modules.title: Proposals & Closing
modules.summary: Outcome, scope, guaranteed floor, price, terms. Hold your floor, trade concessions.
modules.assignment: Proposal template built; a live deal moved to proposal.

campuses.name: LinkedIn (Outbound at Scale)
campuses.promise: LinkedIn as a scaled, safe, multi-account outbound machine feeding the pipeline.
campuses.fastWin: Account warmed correctly, first campaign live with proper naming and sourcing.

modules.title: The Platform Logic
modules.summary: Decision-makers identifiable by role, reachable directly. Account safety is the foundation.

modules.title: The Warm-Up Protocol
modules.summary: Gradual ramp over two weeks to steady state; engagement mixed in to look human.
modules.assignment: Warm-up schedule started on your account, day one.

modules.title: Sourcing Prospects (3 methods)
modules.summary: Sales Nav direct / Sales Nav + scraper / free tier + scraper — pick by budget. The list defines the campaign.
modules.assignment: First list of 200+ ICP-matched prospects.

modules.title: Campaign Architecture & Naming
modules.summary: Region | ICP | Vertical | Offer | Period. Organized, trackable, comparable. One variable per campaign.
modules.assignment: First campaign structured and named.

modules.title: Automation Tools & Sequences
modules.summary: The sequence wired into tooling: humanized delays, lead-timezone sending, behavioral limits.
modules.assignment: Sequence live in your chosen tool.

modules.title: Blocker: Tool Paralysis
modules.summary: You need a warmed account and a good list, not the perfect stack.

modules.title: Multi-Account Scaling
modules.summary: The scaling math — and the quality gate: hold acceptance rate while scaling or fix the list, not the volume.
modules.assignment: Scaling plan; second account warming if resourced.

modules.title: Profile as Landing Page
modules.summary: Headline states the outcome; featured section carries proof; activity shows a real operator.
modules.assignment: Profile rebuilt against the checklist.

modules.title: Reading the Numbers
modules.summary: Acceptance, reply, conversation, pipeline entries. Kill/scale per campaign.
modules.assignment: Two-week review, one evidence-based campaign decision.

campuses.name: IG Organic (The Personal Authority Engine)
campuses.promise: A complete, daily-executable IG system — profile, reels, stories — that builds authority and captures intent-leads.
campuses.fastWin: Your Content Execution Map built and live, first authority reel posted with a keyword CTA.

modules.title: Positioning & the Account as an Asset
modules.summary: The one thing people should DM you for; profile as landing page.
modules.assignment: Positioning statement + rebuilt profile.

modules.title: The Content Execution Map
modules.summary: Every day has a strategic objective; the map kills the daily 'what do I post' decision.
modules.assignment: Your full 7-day map, built and committed to.

modules.title: Story Architecture
modules.summary: The 5–10 slide daily sequence: interactive opener → lesson → proof → personal → repost → tease.
modules.assignment: Run the sequence daily off your map for a week.

modules.title: Steal Like an Artist
modules.summary: Find proven formats, deconstruct the skeleton, remix with your frame. Three registers: green-screen authority, philosophical short-form, case-study reels.
modules.assignment: Deconstruct 5 winning reels; shoot one remix in each register.

modules.title: Blocker: Volume and Ego
modules.summary: You're not posting enough and you're scared of looking stupid.

modules.title: Hooks & the First Second
modules.summary: Hook taxonomy judged by skip rate — how one rewrite moves it.
modules.assignment: 10 hooks against your positioning, tested live.

modules.title: Reading the Data Like an Operator
modules.summary: Skip rate, retention shape, replay signal, non-follower %, saves. Batch-and-ride. The reach/intent inversion.
modules.assignment: Two-week log, one evidence-based kill/scale call.

modules.title: The Keyword Capture Layer
modules.summary: Comment/DM keyword CTAs; capture at solo scale with off-the-shelf tools.
modules.assignment: CTA live on your best-performing format.

modules.title: The Standing Engine
modules.summary: Batching against the map, sustainable cadence, and the honest ceiling.
modules.assignment: Repeatable weekly production system built.

campuses.name: Short-Form Distribution (The Volume Economy)
campuses.promise: Run a distribution campaign engineered as math, not luck — many creators posting at volume.
campuses.fastWin: First campaign modeled and briefed: view target reverse-engineered into budget, roster, script pack.

modules.title: The Volume Economy
modules.summary: Reach = views-per-post × posts. Buy posting slots at saturation. Flood the zone.
modules.assignment: Reverse-engineer a real goal into the volume math.

modules.title: Unit Economics & Campaign Pricing
modules.summary: Cost per post, CPM, floors. Expected-views-per-post is the load-bearing assumption.
modules.assignment: Full campaign model as a keeper spreadsheet.

modules.title: Clippers vs UGC & Sourcing the Roster
modules.summary: When each fires, vetting for real reach, spotting bot farmers, recruitment floors.
modules.assignment: Roster sourced and shortlisted (start 2–4).

modules.title: The Script Pack
modules.summary: Never let creators invent. Multi-variant packs by psychological register collapse quality variance.
modules.assignment: 3–5 variant script/hook pack built.

modules.title: Content Formats for Volume
modules.summary: Faceless, trial reels, fast-cut edits — fast and low-variance wins at 150 posts.
modules.assignment: First batch produced or briefed.

modules.title: Blocker: Delegation & Spending Fear
modules.summary: Perfectionism is the enemy of distribution. Fund the pool and let the math run.

modules.title: Payout Structures & Fraud Control
modules.summary: CPM/flat/bounty/hybrid; why caps get gamed; human-in-the-loop qualification as the defense.
modules.assignment: Payout model + approval criteria documented.

modules.title: Quality Control, Tracking & Reporting
modules.summary: Reviewing at volume, verifying real views, the one-page report that proves it worked.
modules.assignment: Run the batch, review, log verified views, produce the report.

modules.title: Running It Live & The Ceiling
modules.summary: The operational rhythm launch → payout → report — and where solo orchestration caps.
modules.assignment: First live campaign run end to end.

campuses.name: TikTok Live (Real-Time Fan Conversion)
campuses.promise: Live streaming as a fan-conversion and monetization engine.
campuses.fastWin: First structured live streamed with engagement loops and a follow CTA, reviewed against the metrics panel.

modules.title: Why Live Is Different
modules.summary: Attention converts in real time. Comment-to-view ratio and watch time beat raw views.
modules.assignment: Watch three lives in your niche, log the engagement mechanics.

modules.title: Market & Language Targeting
modules.summary: Your live audience is defined by language and stream timing. Stream to the target market's clock.
modules.assignment: Market chosen, schedule set to that market's hours.

modules.title: The Stream Structure
modules.summary: Open, loop, peaks, close. Follow CTAs placed at engagement peaks, not randomly.
modules.assignment: Structure written; first structured live run.

modules.title: Blocker: Fear of the Empty Room
modules.summary: Stream anyway. The room grows because you kept showing up to it.

modules.title: The Gift Economy
modules.summary: Coins → gifts → diamonds at ~half value. Micro-gifts from many beat whale-hunting.
modules.assignment: Gift math for your room size; three micro-gift moments designed in.

modules.title: Consistency & the Algorithm
modules.summary: Same slots, same days; duration compounds discovery; platform comparisons as feedback.
modules.assignment: Two-week consistent schedule, metrics logged per stream.

modules.title: Live as a Funnel Layer
modules.summary: Viewers → followers → DMs → what you sell. Clip your lives into short-form. Recognize the 'can I join' moment.
modules.assignment: Your live-to-next-step path defined and announced on stream.

modules.title: Presence & Performance
modules.summary: Energy over an hour, eye contact, dead rooms, trolls, the setting as brand. Review streams like game film.
modules.assignment: Self-review of two streams against the presence checklist.

campuses.name: Brand & Deals (Monetizing the Name)
campuses.promise: Know what your content is worth, price it properly, negotiate like you're represented.
campuses.fastWin: Your rate card built — deliverables and usage priced separately.

modules.title: What You're Actually Selling
modules.summary: A deal is two products: the deliverable and the usage rights. Price them separately.
modules.assignment: Deliverables listed, separated in writing from usage.

modules.title: Pricing the Deliverable
modules.summary: Tier, platform, engagement quality, format bundles. Niche authority commands a premium.
modules.assignment: Your tiered rate card.

modules.title: Usage Rights as a Revenue Lever
modules.summary: Percentage of deliverable fee scaled by term, territory, media type. Perpetual should cost a fortune.
modules.assignment: Usage-fee schedule as add-on percentages.

modules.title: Blocker: Undercharging Out of Gratitude
modules.summary: A brand in your DMs is already sold. You're the product they came for — price like it.

modules.title: Reading the Deal & Negotiating
modules.summary: Anchoring, floors, trading concessions. Counter lowballs with benchmarks, not emotion.
modules.assignment: Full counter written on a real or mock offer.

modules.title: Contracts & What to Flag
modules.summary: Scope, usage, exclusivity, kill fees, liability — what to catch, then lawyer's eyes.
modules.assignment: Sample contract marked up, every negotiable clause flagged.

modules.title: Payment Terms & Getting Paid
modules.summary: Deposits, milestones, kill fees, invoicing rhythm. Protect the money.
modules.assignment: Standard payment terms + invoice template.

modules.title: Inbound vs Outbound Deals
modules.summary: Brands finding you vs you pitching. A media kit that closes.
modules.assignment: Media kit built.

modules.title: Running It Like a Business & The Ceiling
modules.summary: Tracking, rebooking, raising rates — and the point you want representation.
modules.assignment: Deal tracker live with every active conversation.

campuses.name: YouTube (Long-Form Authority)
campuses.promise: A long-form home that converts short-form attention into deep trust.
campuses.fastWin: First video published from material you already have.

modules.title: YouTube's Job in This System
modules.summary: Short-form is discovery; YouTube is depth. The proof shelf, not the algorithm chase.

modules.title: The Content Spine
modules.summary: Teardown/case study (proof), process video (authority), story video (connection) — from what already exists.
modules.assignment: First three videos planned from existing material.

modules.title: Packaging
modules.summary: Titles and thumbnails as the hook layer; the promise the video must keep.
modules.assignment: Title/thumbnail drafts for the first three.

modules.title: Production Reality
modules.summary: Minimum viable workflow; one long-form becomes a week of short-form.
modules.assignment: First video published.

modules.title: The Panel
modules.summary: CTR, average view duration, returning viewers. Judge on trend, not video.
modules.assignment: 30-day review.

campuses.name: CRM & Systems
campuses.promise: The operational backend — pipelines, triggers, SOPs, dashboards — a machine someone else could run.
campuses.fastWin: CRM live with every active lead staged and a next action on each.

modules.title: Source of Truth
modules.summary: ONE place where state lives. Comms happen where the client prefers; state lives in the system.
modules.assignment: Tool chosen, workspace created.

modules.title: Pipeline Design
modules.summary: Outbound, sales, reactivation. A record without a next action is a dead record.
modules.assignment: Pipelines built, all live deals imported and staged.

modules.title: Blocker: System Avoidance
modules.summary: You think you'll remember. You won't. The boring thing is the business.

modules.title: Triggers & Automation
modules.summary: Events fire actions. Manual first, automated second.
modules.assignment: Five triggers defined and running.

modules.title: Lead Imports & List Hygiene
modules.summary: Dedupe, tag by source/campaign, stage deep-funnel vs cold. Old tagged leads are found money.
modules.assignment: Full historical lead import, tagged and staged.

modules.title: SOPs by Role
modules.summary: Roles, never names. Could a new hire run this from the document alone?
modules.assignment: One full SOP for your most repeated process.

modules.title: Dashboards & the Weekly Review
modules.summary: Pipeline value, stage conversion, activity, aging. What moved, what stalled, what leaks.
modules.assignment: Dashboard built, first weekly review done.

modules.title: Hiring Into the System
modules.summary: You hand off a documented machine, not chaos.
modules.assignment: Delegation map: first handoff + the SOP that enables it.

campuses.name: CRM Lite (Artists)
campuses.promise: A lightweight system so nothing valuable dies in the DMs.
campuses.fastWin: Three lists built and populated from your actual DMs.

modules.title: The Artist's Pipeline
modules.summary: Industry contacts, active opportunities, superfans — built from your DMs.
modules.assignment: All three lists built and populated.

modules.title: Blocker: 'I'll Reply Later'
modules.summary: Later is where money goes to die.

modules.title: Opportunity Staging
modules.summary: New → In Conversation → Terms → Confirmed → Delivered → Paid.
modules.assignment: Live opportunities staged.

modules.title: Follow-Up Triggers
modules.summary: 7 days silent → follow up; delivered → invoice; paid → thank + rebook window.
modules.assignment: Triggers set.

modules.title: The Weekly Review
modules.summary: Fifteen minutes: what moved, what's stalling, who to follow up.
modules.assignment: First review done.
